title: Claude Code + Blender = Insane 3D Renders
script: What if I told you that I made this 3D animation without ever opening Blender?
And no, this isn't from an AI video model like VEO or SeaDance.
Claude 3 Opus 5.5 wrote the whole thing as code.
It built the After Effects interface as a webpage.
It wrote a Python script that builds a 3D scene in Blender.
It animated this little guy hopping across the buttons, and it even made the music and every
single sound effect from scratch.
Then, Blender rendered all 360 frames on my GPU in about 15 minutes, and FFmpeg stitched them
